Scalar-field NTT Reed-Solomon ground truth, computed independently of the library.

Produced by scalar_ntt_anchor.py in a local, untracked anchor-harness directory (development
tooling outside this repository's tracked tree): pure Python 3 integer arithmetic (pow/Horner),
no third-party libraries. Regenerate with:

  py <local-anchor-harness>\scalar_ntt_anchor.py > test\Lumoin.Veridical.Tests\TestMaterial\ScalarNtt\scalar-ntt-anchor-output.txt

Field orders r are the BLS12-381 and BN254 (alt_bn128) scalar-field orders. The domain
generators g are prime quadratic nonresidues matching the conventional multiplicative
generators of published parameter tables for these fields: 7 for BLS12-381 (5 is a smaller
nonresidue but not the convention) and 5 for BN254 (the smallest). omega_2pK denotes
g^((r-1)/2^K) mod r, the primitive 2^K-th root of unity the library derives at run time.

The cwNxM codewords anchor the systematic Reed-Solomon extension over consecutive-integer
nodes: the polynomial with coefficients c_i = i*i + 42 + 1000*N + M (i in [0, N)) is
evaluated by Horner's rule at the points 0..M-1; the first N values are the message and the
remaining values are the extension the engine must reproduce. Every value is one scalar
field element as exactly 64 hex characters (32 canonical big-endian bytes).
